With reference to Supt Tan Shao Liang's report of October 27 on the subject of the extradition of certain persons arrested in connection with the raids on communist bases at 136 Shanse Road on October 15 and 1859 Sinza Road on October 24 (Files Nos. D.4123 and D.4154) I have to state that the Municipal Police in preferring a charge against the accused acted only in accordance with the terms of the Rendition Agreement, as the offence had been committed in the Settlement. Therefore, the Municipal Police represented by the Legal Department, unquestionably have the right to request that the prisoners be detained for enquiries since the documents seized in these raids also affect the territory under their jurisdiction. However, taking into consideration that the original information leading to these arrests emanated from the Chinese authorities, who are reported to have in their custody other prisoners who have implicated the accused, the Municipal Police raise no objection to their extradition provided of course, that the P.S.B. can establish a prima facie case against the accused and that they are wanted for communist activities in Chinese controlled territory. As this question comes within the province of the Legal Department, I beg to suggest that the Acting M.S. be consulted with a view to making arrangements to facilitate cases of this nature.

Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 25/10/32

Raid on Communist Base - 6 arrests

Acting on information supplied by the Chinese
Authorities, the Municipal Police at 11.30 a.m. October 24,
raided the kitchen room of house No.1859 Sinza Road, and
arrested five persons who were holding a meeting there.
A search of the premises unearthed a quantity of communist
literature bearing on agitation among workers. As a
result of a watch kept on the premises, one further arrest
was made. The accused will appear before Court on October 25,
when an application for their extradition to the Chinese
Authorities will be made.

1932年10月25日每日情报报告摘录

突袭共产主义据点 - 6人被捕

根据中国当局提供的情报，市政警察于10月24日上午11时30分，突袭了新闸路1859号房屋的厨房，并逮捕了正在那里开会的五人。对住所的搜查发现了大量涉及煽动工人的共产主义宣传品。由于对该住所进行了监视，又逮捕了一人。被告人将于10月25日出庭，届时将申请将其引渡给中国当局。

Chang Tung Ching (张东清) 27, Kiangsi.
Kiangsi
B'well St'n. 25-10-32 Y.B. Pu.
States,
I am a native of An Yuen hsien, Kiangsi. My home address
is at No. 570 Wai Si Doo, North Gate, Changsha, Honan, where my
parents reside and my father works as a book dealer.
I am 27 years old and am single. I came to Shanghai 2 days
ago to find a job and have no fixed abode. I have known Zung Pah
Ming, who is living at 1359 Sinza Road, for over one year, and
today I called there to visit him. I was there only half an hour
when the Police arrived. I have been in S'hai for 2 years and
worked as a journalist in the Sse-Yun Press at Palm Road for
few days only, when Police raided that Press and I was arrested
with some ten others. I was imprisoned for 6 months in the Ward
Road Gaol. I was released in the Winter of 1930. 3 or 4 weeks
after my release, in April or May the following year, I was again
arrested in connection with a murder, which took place in front
of the Peking Theatre. For this I was imprisoned for 8 months
and released in Jan. 1931. At the end of Feby 1931 I returned to
my home in Changsha. I was educated in Changsha and can read
and write Chinese. I am not a communist at all and receive
no monetary support from the Communist Party.

张东清（Chang Tung Ching），27岁，江西籍。
江西
静安寺警局 1932年10月25日 Y.B. Pu.
陈述，
我是江西省安远县人。我的家庭住址是河南长沙北门外的司门口570号，我的父母居住在那里，父亲从事书商职业。
我今年27岁，未婚。我两天前来上海找工作，没有固定住所。我认识住在新闸路1359号的曾伯明（Zung Pah Ming，音译）已有一年多，今天我去那里拜访他。我只在那里待了半小时，警察就到了。我在上海待过两年，曾在帕尔姆路（Palm Road，即今襄阳南路附近）的四云印务馆（Sse-Yun Press）做过几天记者，当时警察突袭了该印务馆，我与另外十余人一同被捕。我在华德路监狱服刑6个月。我于1930年冬季获释。获释后3或4周，即次年4月或5月，我因一起发生在北京大戏院前的谋杀案再次被捕。为此我被监禁8个月，于1931年1月获释。1931年2月底，我回到长沙家中。我在长沙受过教育，能读写中文。我根本不是共产党员，也没有接受共产党的任何金钱资助。

Zung Puh Ming( 陈伯明), 28 .
Szechuen.
B'well St'n.           25-10-32                  Y.B.Pu.
States,
      My name is Zung Puh Ming. I am 28 years of age, a native
of Szechuen, and live at No. 1859 Sinza Road.   My native home
address is at No. 67 Ma Kya, Kyien Wei Hsien, Szechuen.
      I came to Shanghai in February 1931 from Szechuen to find a
job, and eventually obtained one in the China General Omnibus Co.
conductor No. 87 with a monthly salary of $23.00  I was dismissed
in April or May 1932 for having trouble with an Inspector. Up to
now, I have lived upon the money gained when employed as a C.G.O.
conductor.      I have received 3 years education in Szechuen, and
I can read and write well.    I have a friend named Wong Tien Yu
(王天有)who accompanied me to Shanghai last year. He himself
afterwards went to Nanking to study in the Central College.
Lately, I have received no communications from him.
      I know one named Tai Siau Poh( 戴小波 ), who is an ex-Bus
conductor No. 89. The latter called on me at my home 1859 Sinza
Road to ask me if I knew something about the Tramways for which
firm I am now recruiting conductors. I had a friend in the Tram-
ways before, but now he has been dismissed. Later Siau Poh's
friend(Tsen Poh Kang)(曾伯刚) together with another man Hu Ying
Sai(胡英赛) came into my house to find Siau Poh. We talked only
over Tramways business for about half an hour, when the Police
arrived, and took us into custody. I am not interested in any
political party and I don't know what is meant by a communist.

陈伯明（Zung Puh Ming），28岁。
四川籍。
静安寺警局           1932年10月25日                  Y.B.Pu.
陈述，
      我叫陈伯明（Zung Puh Ming）。我今年28岁，四川人，住在新闸路1859号。我的原籍地址是四川省剑威县（Kyien Wei Hsien，音译）马家67号。
      我于1931年2月从四川来到上海找工作，最终在中国公共汽车公司（China General Omnibus Co.）找到了一份工作，担任87号售票员，月薪23.00美元。我于1932年4月或5月因与一名督察发生纠纷而被解雇。到目前为止，我一直靠担任中国公共汽车公司售票员时赚取的积蓄生活。      我在四川受过3年教育，能熟练读写。      我有一个朋友叫王天有（Wong Tien Yu），去年他陪我来到上海。他后来去了南京，在中央学院（Central College）读书。最近，我没有收到他的来信。
      我认识一个叫戴小波（Tai Siau Poh）的人，他是前89号公交车售票员。后者来到我家（新闸路1859号）拜访，问我是否了解电车公司的情况，该公司目前正在招聘售票员。我以前在电车公司有个朋友，但现在他已被解雇。后来，戴小波的朋友曾伯刚（Tsen Poh Kang）和另一个叫胡英赛（Hu Ying Sai）的人来到我家找戴小波。我们只谈了约半小时的电车业务，警察就到了，并将我们拘留。我对任何政党都不感兴趣，也不知道什么是共产主义。

Soochow

    My name is Tai Siau Poh. I am 20 years of age, married and

read and write Chinese, and understand a little English. I then
joined the S.T. Co. as a repairer in the Auto Room, with a monthly

I then obtained a job as conductor No. 59 in the China General

    I am not interested in any political party, and have received

one named Kung Poh King(龚伯明), ex-Bus conductor No. 57, on Kinache

He arranged with me to call on him at 1600 Siqua Road yesterday.

戴小波（Tai Siau Poh），20岁
苏州籍
静安寺警局           1932年10月25日                  Y.B. Pu.
陈述，
    我叫戴小波。我今年20岁，已婚，苏州人。我的家庭住址是苏州洞庭东山翠宗里甸zien总（Chui Zung Liy Dien Zien Tsung，音译）。我住在上海罗宾森路（Robison Road）的大学里（Dah Sueh Li，音译）。我大约3或4年前来到上海。
    我最初在陈儒（Chenju，音译）的中国大学读书，在那里待了3年。我于1931年6月离开大学。我能读写中文，懂一点英语。随后我加入上海电车公司（S.T. Co.），在汽车间担任修理工，月薪28.00美元，并于1932年7月从那里被解雇。随后我在中国公共汽车公司找到了一份工作，担任59号售票员，月薪23.00美元。在那里工作了约3周后，我于8月底因贪污（squeeze）被解雇，至今一直失业。
    我对任何政党都不感兴趣，也没有接受共产党的任何金钱资助。两天前，我在基纳切路（Kinache Road，音译）遇见一个叫龚伯明（Kung Poh King）的人，他是前57号公交车售票员，他告诉我电车公司正在招聘售票员。他安排我昨天去西摩路1600号找他。我没有履行承诺，但我今天早上去了那里。我只在那里待了半小时，警察就到了，并将我们（共5人）拘留。

pages.en:
Tseu Foh Kung (周福根), 28 years.

Yangchow.

B^r Station    1-11-32.    translated    (Clerk) Chang.
States.

I am married. My native home address is at Kwong Tse Hon,
Yangchow (揚州廣儲門). I am living in an unnumbered straw hut, on
Kiaochow Road, Shanghai.

I have been in Shanghai for the past 3 years and I am a
fruit hawker. I have never studied Chinese. At 10a.m. the 26-10-
32, while I was walking along Sinza and Kiaochow Rd's corner, I met
Tai Siau Poh (戴小波) who was formerly a conductor of China General
Omnibus Company and who owed me 55 coppers for fruit. I asked him
to pay me the sum of 55 coppers, but he stated that he had no money
in his pocket, temporarily, whereupon I followed him to a fuel shop
at Xong Kuh Jau, Sinza Road, where he told me to wait at the entrance of the said shop. For twenty minutes he did not come out, so
I entered and saw Tai Siau Poh (戴小波) talking with 2 unknown men.
In the meantime I was invited to sit down. Then we were arrested
8 minutes later by Police. I am not a member of any political or
Communist party.
pages.zh:
周福根（Tseu Foh Kung），28岁。

扬州籍。

B^r 警局    1932年11月1日。    翻译    （书记员）张。
陈述。

我已婚。我的原籍地址是扬州广储门（Kwong Tse Hon, Yangchow）。我住在上海胶州路一间无门牌号的草棚里。

我在上海已过去3年，是一名水果小贩。我从未学过中文。1932年10月26日上午10时，当我走到新闸路和胶州路拐角处时，遇见了前中国公共汽车公司售票员戴小波，他欠我55枚铜板的水果钱。我要求他支付55枚铜板，但他声称口袋里暂时没钱，于是我跟随他到新闸路松古焦（Xong Kuh Jau，音译）的一家燃料店，他让我在该店门口等候。过了二十分钟他还没出来，我便进去，看见戴小波正与两名陌生男子交谈。与此同时，我被邀请坐下。8分钟后，我们被警察逮捕。我不是任何政治党派或共产党的成员。

pages.en:
Ts Ah Ling(朱阿林). 38 years of age.
Chinkiang.
B'well St'n.          25-10-32          Clerk Van( S.Branch)
Stated,
My name is Ts Ah Ling. I have a wife and a boy who are residing at 1860 Kai Yoong Paung, Sinza Road. They pay a monthly rent of $5.00 and have lived there since August 1931. I came to Shanghai when I was 17 years of age, in company with my father, mother and younger brother named Ts Shing Kai(朱新開) a broker of the Wong Yuan Sing(王元盛) Pile Shop off Dalny Road. I became an apprentice on board s.s. Xiang Soo(祥蘇) of the C.M.N.C. for 4 years. I was then employed as a coolie on various steamers until 1930, after which I was unemployed. In Sept. 1932 I was engaged on board the s.s. Sing Kee(星記) of the Sing Kee Navigation Company, Zang Ran(張然) Chekiang. I came to Shanghai yesterday to visit my home. This morning at about 10.30a.m. I heard some people saying that the police had raided No. 1860 Chung Yuen Paung Sinza Road and had arrested some robbers. I entered the back room of the latter premises with a view to seeing what kind of room the robbers were arrested. I was then arrested by a Chinese detective. I can neither read nor write and am not a member of any political party. I know nothing about the people arrested. This is my true statement.

朱阿林（Ts Ah Ling）。38岁。
镇江籍。
静安寺警局          1932年10月25日          书记员 Van (南区分局)
陈述，
我叫朱阿林。我有一妻一子，居住在新闸路凯荣坊（Kai Yoong Paung，音译）1860号。他们每月支付租金5.00美元，自1931年8月起便居住在那里。我17岁时随父母和弟弟朱新开（Ts Shing Kai）来到上海，弟弟是大连路（Dalny Road）王元盛（Wong Yuan Sing）堆栈的经纪人。我在中国招商局（C.M.N.C.）的祥苏轮（s.s. Xiang Soo）上做了4年学徒。随后我在各艘轮船上做苦力，直到1930年，之后一直失业。1932年9月，我受雇于浙江人张然（Zang Ran）所有的星记轮船公司（Sing Kee Navigation Company）的星记轮（s.s. Sing Kee）。我昨天来上海探望家人。今天上午约10时30分，我听到有人说警察突袭了新闸路中原坊（Chung Yuen Paung，音译）1860号，逮捕了一些强盗。我进入该住所的后屋，想看看强盗是在什么样的房间里被捕的。随后我被一名华探逮捕。我不识字，也不是任何政党的成员。我对被捕的人一无所知。这是我的真实陈述。

pages.en:
Hu Ying San ( 胡英三 ), 26 years.
Hupeh.
B'well St'n.           25-10-: 2           Y.B. Pu.

States,

My name is Hu Ying San, I am 26 years of age, single, and
a native of Hupeh. My home address in Hupeh was at Tung Shiang
Village, Woochang Hsien. I only came to Shanghai today, on the
instructions of my master Wong Jai Ying ( 黄再英 ) who is a teacher
in the Kinling College, Nanking, for whom I worked as a teaboy.
I received from him a monthly wage of $12.00 My master is of the
same nativity as myself. He instructed me to come to Shanghai
as he had a job for me, and told me to call on him at the "Tsiang
Yuen Young" at Sinsa and Kiaochow Roads corner. As I was calling
there, I was arrested by detectives. I have only studied one year
and I can't read or write. I am not interested in any political
party and I don't know what is meant by Communist.

湖北籍。
静安寺捕房           1932年10月25日           黄色巡捕。

陈述如下：

我叫胡英三，现年26岁，未婚，湖北人。我在湖北的住址是武昌县桐乡村。我今日才抵达上海，是奉我的主人黄再英（Wong Jai Ying）之命前来的。黄再英是南京金陵大学的教员，我曾在他家做茶房。他每月付给我工资12.00元。我的主人与我是同乡。他指示我来上海，说这里有工作给我，并让我去新闸路与胶州路拐角处的“蒋源永”（Tsiang Yuen Young，音译）找他。当我前往该处时，被侦探逮捕。我只读过一年书，不会读写。我对任何政党都不感兴趣，也不知道“共产党”是什么意思。
